sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.date as open_date, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date LIKE '1993%' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM account a2 JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND a2.date LIKE '1993%')
